migrationNotes: The source page is a single Squarespace code block with custom HTML/CSS/JS. Its visual furniture — hero band, sticky chip subnav (HOW! Series / Resources / Calendar / Contact), three-way tabbed resource panel, 'SR' initials badge, and 'Back to top' button — is presentation only and was not carried across; the underlying content is all preserved.
The page contains no photographs or content images at all, so photos/pages/coachinghub/ was not created.

The Google Calendar embed uses a /calendar/u/1/embed URL, which is user-account-scoped. It may only render for the signed-in Google account that created it; a public /calendar/embed?src=... URL would be safer. Calendar id: 482985e3abcb867d1bfb1eb9e37e3d172917e23626d1f655adeb943090fab5e6@group.calendar.google.com
The coaching contact is a personal Gmail address (scottroberts1269@gmail.com) rather than an swlawnbowls.org address — worth confirming it is still the right contact.
The 'Coaching Calendar' section promises upcoming sessions but the page itself lists no dated events; everything depends on the embedded calendar being populated.
No PDFs were linked from this page, so nothing is at risk from Squarespace file hosting going away.
